tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs

bir lugs kyi mchan dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad e wam̐/ e shes rab kyi srung ba/ bam̐ thabs kyi srung ba/ bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las pad ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan la bzhugs te/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms la/ srung 'khor gyi nang du pad nyi'i steng na rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsgom pa bstan/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rjes lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs rdo rje phar 'phros sems can thams cad kyi don byas nas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin tshur 'dus nas rdo rje rnam 'joms su bsgoms la snyoms par bzhugs so// de nas lag g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas na rdo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad de ltar dam tshig bskyed nas ye shes pa gzhug pa/ kyi mthu dang*/ bdud bzhi'i bar chad 'joms pa/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ de la dbang bskur ba bstan/ byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes pas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis skye mched byin gyis brlab pa bstan/ rdo rje khro bo las byung ba/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i ngo bo yin pas/ de las ngag tu hūm̐ brjod cing khro bo bcu 'byin pas rdo rje snying pos rab tu smras te/ mi cho ka da pa/ gshin rje mthar byed/ mi shig kha sa pa/ shes rab mthar byed/ bden ga pa/ pad+ma mthar byed/ sra nga ba/ bgegs mthar byed/ brten ca pa/ mi g.yo ba/ thams cad du thogs

cha pa 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ med pa/ thams cad da ja ུ ma pham pa/ dbyug sngon can/ sems can nya thams cad skrag stobs po che/ par byed pa/ sems can ta thams cad 'jil gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ bar byed pa/ rig sngags thams tha cad gnod mdzes/ gcod par byed pa/ de dag gi phrin las/ rig sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa/ rang gi las ngan pa/ las thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gzhan gyis las ngan pa thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ gdon chen po bco brgyad la sogs pa/ gdon thams cad brlag par byed pa/ gdon thams cad las gza' chen po brgyad/ thar bar byed pa/ 'byung po 'i rigs thams cad 'gugs par byed pa/ dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i/ rig sngags kyi las thams cad dbyug sngon stobs chen gnyis 'dis gzir/ byed du 'jug pa/ las sngar ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa/ grub pa sngar zin/ rnams chu mi za ba/ bdag dang gzhan la ci dang ci/ 'dod pa thun mong gi las thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ spyi'i las sems can thams cad srung bar byed pa/ rtsa ba'i las bzhi sdig pa la sogs pa zhi ba/ tshe sogs rgyas pa/ mngon spyod sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum rengs par byed pa/ dbang rmugs par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi mthu chen po 'di sangs rgyas kyi mthus dam tshig sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras so/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ston/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa gtum po phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po la se na pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ 'di lta ste/ oṃ tra ṭa 1 tra ṭa/ tro ṭa ya 2 tro ṭa ya/ s+phu ṭa 3 s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya 4 s+pho ṭa ya/ ghur+ṇa ghu 5 r+ṇa/ ghur+ṇā pa ya ghu

6 r+ṇā pa ya/ sems can ces pa sngags kyi phrad/ sarba sa 7 twa ni/ bodha 8 bodha/ saṃ bo dha ya 9 saṃ bo dha ya/ bh+ra ma 10 bh+ra ma/ saṃ bh+ra ma ya 11 saṃ bh+ra ma ya/ sarba bhu ta ni/ 'byung po thams cad pa ste phrad/ ku ṭa ku 12 ṭa/ saṃ ku ṭa ya 13 saṃ ku ṭa ya/ dgra bo thams cad phrad/ sarba sha 14 truṃ naṃ/ gha ṭa gha 15 ṭa ya/ saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha 16 ṭa ya/ sarba bi d+yā badz+ra 17 badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ba 18 dz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa ba 19 dz+re badz+ra/ ma ṭa ba 20 dz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha ba 21 dz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa ha sa 22 nī la badz+ra/ su badz+rā ya swā 23 hā/ he phu lu 24 / ni ru phu 25 lu/ mi li tsu 26 lu/ gṛh+ṇa ku 27 lu/ ku ru ku 28 lu/ badz+ra bi dza yā ya 29 swā hā/ kī li kī lā 30 ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka 31 ṭa/ ma ṭa ma 32 ṭa/ ra ṭa 33 ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na pra 34 mo ṭa nā ya swā hā/ tsa ra ni tsa 35 ra/ ha ra 36 ha ra/ sa ra 37 sa ra/ mā ra ya 38 mā ra ya/ badz+ra bi dā 39 ra ya swā hā/ tshin+dha 40 tshin+dha/ bin+dha bi 41 n+dha/ ma hā 42 kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ bhan+dha bha 43 n+dha/ kro dha kī li kī lā 44 ya swā hā/ tsu ru 45 tsu ru/ tsa 46 ṇ+ḍa kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ tra sa ya 47 tra sa ya/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya 48 swā hā/ ha ra ha ra 49 badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra 50 pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra 51 bhañdza nā ya swā hā/ ma tis+thi ra 52 badz+ra/ su tis+thi ra ba 53 dz+ra/ pra tis+thi ra 54 badz+ra/ ma hā ba 55 dz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta ba 56 dz+ra/ a mo gha ba 57 dz+ra/ e h+ye hi ba 58 dz+ra/ shī gh+raṃ badz+ra ya 59 swā hā/ dha ra dha 60 ra/ dhi ri 61 dhi ri/ dhu ru dha 62 ུ ru/ rigs thams cad de phrad/ sarba 63 gu laṃ/ ā brta ya 64 swā hā/ che ge mo god cig pa ste phrad/ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ na maḥsaman+ta badz+ra ṇā na/ sarba badz+ra ku laṃ ā brta ya/ ma hā ba 1 dz+ra/ gshin rje mthar byed/ ma hā ba 2 le/ shes rab mthar byed/ ka ta 3 bai/ pad+ma mthar byed/ ta ta 4 le/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ a tsa 5 le/ mi g.yo ba/ maṇ+ḍa la 6 ma ye/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po/

a ti ba 7 dz+ra/ dbyug sngon can/ ma hā ba 8 le/ stobs po che/ be ge ra ṇa 9 ra ṇa/ gtsug gtor 'khor los sgyur ba/ a 10 dzi te/ gnod mdzes/ dz+wa la 1 / de rnams skul ba'i phrin las bcu/ dz+wa la 2 / ti ṭi ti 3 ṭi/ ting ga 4 le/ da ha da 5 ha/ te tsa pa 6 ti/ ti li 7 ti li/ ban+dha ba 8 n+dha/ ma hā ba 9 le/ badz+ra aṃ 10 ku sha dz+wa lā ya swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ snying po ste khro bo bcu'i sngags/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha 1 ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma 2 tha badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na ba 3 dz+ra/ da ha da ha 4 badz+ra/ pa tsa pa 5 tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra 6 badz+ra/ dha ra ya dha ra 7 ya badz+ra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa ba 8 dz+ra/ tshin+dha tshin+dha 9 badz+ra/ bhiṇ+ḍha bhiṇ+ḍha 10 badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ yang snying*/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ de ltar bzlas pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ de'i 'bras bu/ /sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed/ rgyud sde bzhi po/ /rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste/ gnas skabs kyi dpal tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa/ mthar thug gi dpal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ /dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan// sems can dbang po mig la sogs pa nyams pa dang*/ las kyi stobs kyis bgegs la sogs pas/ /tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang*/ /mi mthun pa'i phyogs phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha'am srung ba'i lha gzhan/ /lha rnams rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang*// mdza' dus yod pa'i sdug skye bo sdang bar 'gyur ba dang*// bram ze 'am dge sbyong la sogs dmod pa grub pas gtses pa dang*// phan tshun 'khon grib sam 'thab rtsod kyis mthun pa ma yin dang*// nor med pa'i stobs kyis phongs te lha'am mi dag gi zil gyis gnon cing*/

'gribs pas ni gnod pa dang*// mya ngan gyi gnod pa bzhi mngal las bdag po med pa'i sbrum ma/ gnod pa dang*/ dgra bgegs kyi/ 'jigs pa dang ni phongs pa'i stobs kyi bkres pa dang*// gza' brgyad kyi dang rgyu skar skar mda' lhung ba byad stems kyis btab pa dang*/ gdon chen po bco brgyad la sogs pa/ mi bzad gdon gyis nyen pa dang*// mya ngan byed dus su mngal chags pa las byung ba mu ge'i gnod pa yi// rmi lam du lus 'dam gyis gos pa'am dngos su dri nga ba la sogs pa'i sdig pa mthong na yang*/ gang zag /des ni rab bkrus gtsang sbra dang ldan pa gtsang ma yis/ /bslab pa gsum dang ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pa'i mdo dang sde dam pa mnyan par bya/ sgrub pa po/ gang dag byang sems kyis zin pas/ yid dge sems mi dmigs pa'i rgyas btab pas dang dang zhing*/ dri zhim pos bsgos pa la sogs pa'i gos gyon te/ gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te/ gting dpag dka' bas /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ rgya che ba/ /mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na// mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis// srog chags dag ni thams cad kyi// mi bzad pa yi nad mdze la sogs pa dang gi sgras de ma yin pa'i gnod pa gzhan yang bsdu/ rnams dang*/ sngar bstan pa'i mi dge ba /de dag thams cad zhi bar blta/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ bum rdzas /nor bu nyungs kar dūr ba dang*// rin chen sman lnga 'bru lnga rin po che lnga la sogs pa'i bcud rma med tsan+dan bcas// shel dang rdo rje me tog dang*/ bum pa'i steng du bzhag la/ lu ma la sogs pa'i /chu yis bum pa'i rgyu

gser ram yang na ni// dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung*/ kyang gi sgras rdzas la sogs pa'ang bsdu/ /gtsang ma'i gos kyis mgul chings dkris shing bum pa dgang*/ bzlas pa'i grangs rtsa sngags lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam// yang na snying po nye snying lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms cho ga bzhin du bsgom zhing*/ bar gyi tshig mi mngon par ste 'dis mtshon nas gtor ma dang sbyin sreg la sogs pa gzhan yang gyis shig par bsdu'o/ bzlas nas ni/ sngon byung gi dbang du byas pa/ rgyal po zhes bos nas rtag tu khrus gyis shig /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa'o/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms gting mtha' med gzhung la// blo zhan kho bos dpag par mi nus kyang*// grags pa rgyal mtshan gsung gis phye ba yi// rjes su zhugs te 'di yang spel ba lags/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i man ngag dpal sa skya pa'i gsung bzhin/ skad gnyis smra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mchan du btab pa'o// ༈ /rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs bya tshul lo// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa nas byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma chad pa ni/ de nas lag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ zhes pa'i don maṇ+ḍal/ bum pa/ mchod pa/ gtor ma la sogs sta gon byas nas/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bzlas pa gtor ma rnams grub nas/ bla ma la maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gang gi drin gyis lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ bla ma dang slob ma gnyis char gyis dmigs pa bzung la byin gyis brlab pa ni/

bla ma'i thugs ka'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rlung phyir rgyu ba dang mthun pa'i hūm̐ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros slob ma'i rlung nang du 'jug pa dang mthun par snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ lus kyi nang gang bas ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros gnas khang yul 'khor la sogs 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang bar bsgom/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rdo rje'i hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros snga ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ gu gul gyi dud pa dang hūm̐ nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod cing mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thogs pa med par byin gyis brlabs nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par bya'o// de nas slob ma lhar bskyed la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas la// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma ma lus pa dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'o// de nas rang 'od kyi rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i mkha' nas 'od zer dkar dmar mgrin pa'i nang du thim/ lus thams cad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ rang 'od kyi rig ma dang thabs shes rab gnyis med kyi sbyor ba'i phyag rgya pad dkor dang bcas pa bya'o// de nas zag bcas kyi bde ba de zag med stong pa gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i chu zla lta bu'o// de nas rjes kyi bya ba kye rdor dang mthun par bya'o// rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa skya pa las brgyud pa byin rlabs bar ma chad pa'o// sa map+ta mi thi// ༈ /rnam 'joms kyi rnam par bshad pa'o// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu phrag rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi khro bo bcu gcig bdun dang lnga phrag gcig /dpal ldan dkyil 'khor gnyis

khro bo dang khro mo'i rim pa bral bsgrub par// btud de rnam gang zag dbang po rno rtul bzhi bzung ba'i phyir// brgyad phrag rgyud sde bzhi phyed kyi bla ma dbye/ 'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pa'i gsung gi gdams pa dpal sa skya pa chen po las rim par brgyud pa'i rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa'i rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i man ngag gcig nas gcig tu byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma chad pa ngo mtshar dang bcas pa 'di bri ba la skyon med do// de'ang rgyud las/ rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste// dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan// zhes 'byung bas gang zag sbyang pa che 'bring gis rgyud sde bzhi dang sgo bstun nas mngon par rtogs pa gcig nyid la bye brag mi 'dra ba bzhi 'byung ba yin te/ de ltar mdun du bskyed na bya ba'i rgyud/ bdag dang mdun gnyis kar bskyed na spyod pa'i rgyud/ bdag 'ba' zhig tu bskyed la ye shes sems dpa'/ gshegs su gsol na rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sgrub pa yin no// de lta bu'i tshul de dag bsgom na gsum ste/ thabs kyi bsrung ba dang*/ shes rab kyi bsrung ba dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i bsrung ba'o// dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba'i rjes la sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa bsgom snyam pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas dngos po mtha' dag nam mkha' ltar yul snang ba mi dmigs par stong par bsgom pa'o// gsum pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i rwa ba gur bla re me ri 'bar ba/ de'i nang du srung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ de'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan no// de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa spros bsdus gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa margad ltar ljang ba/

cung zad khro ba/ yid tsam 'dzum pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dril bu dkur 'chang ba/ zhabs phyed krung rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa 'byin pa'i tshul du hūm̐ zhes brjod/ khro bo bcu rdo rje gur las 'byung ba bzhin phyogs bcur spros/ phyi rol gyi 'phar ma la rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi phyogs mtshams su brgyad brgyad spros te/ de'ang shar gyi rnams dkar po/ lho'i rnams ser po/ nub kyi rnams dmar po/ byang gi rnams ljang gu/ mtshams kyi rnams phyed gzugs so// thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ shar gyi rnams kyi g.yas pas 'khor lo/ lho'i rin chen/ nub kyi pad+ma/ byang gi ral gri/ byang shar gyis mig gis spras pa'i 'khor lo/ shar lho'i rdo rje/ lho nub kyi pad+ma/ nub byang gi ut+pal/ g.yon pa thams cad sdigs mdzub/ yang na thams cad la rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par bsgoms kyang rung gsungs so// de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab ste/ gshin rje mthar byed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gtso bo la sogs pa gzhan mi bskyod pa'o// rdo rje pho nya mo rnams shar la sogs pa rim pa ltar rnam snang dang*/ rin 'byung dang*/ 'od dpag med dang*/ don yod grub pa'o// byang shar gyi rnam snang*/ shar lho'i mi bskyod pa/ lho nub kyi 'od dpag med/ nub byang gi don yod grub pas dbu brgyan po// mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa'i rim pa'o// de nas sngags kyi bzlas pa la gnyis te/ bsnyen pa dang las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ nye snying gtso bo 'ba' zhig gi'o// snying po khro bo bcu dang thun mong ba'o// rtsa sngags rdo rje pho nya mo rnams dang thun mong ba'o// de ltar gsang sngags de dag mtshan ma mthong ba'am/

'bum phrag bzhi la sogs pa bsnyen par bya'o// las sbyor ni gang zag rab bsam gtan la brten pa tsam gyis grub bo// 'bring sngags dang bsam gtan gnyis kyis 'grub bo// tha mas de dag gi steng du 'khor lo la brten te 'grub bo// shin tu tha mas de dag gi steng du sbyin sreg gi las kyis 'grub ba'o// dang po ni/ zhi rgyas la sogs pa mngon par rtogs pa bsgom zhing sdig pa zhi ba dang tshe rgyas pa la sogs pa ji ltar bsam pa de dang de thogs pa med par 'grub bo// gnyis pa ni/ yid kyis snga ma bzhin bsams la ngag gis sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis 'grub bo// gsum pa ni/ bri ba'i gzhi gro ga'am/ ras sam shing shun la'o// snag tsha ni tsan+dan dkar po dang*/ srin lag gi rgyun nam/ rgya skyegs dang gur gum mam/ 'gi wang dang*/ dug dang*/ khrag dang*/ skye tshe dang*/ yungs kar rnams rim pa bzhin zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang mngon spyod rnams la'o// 'khor lo'i dbyibs ni rtsibs bcu pa/ lte ba dang mu khyud du bcas pa'i dbus su nye snying spel tshig dang bcas pa/ rtsibs bcu la snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa/ mu khyud la rtsa sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa bri'o// de la rab tu gnas pa legs par byas/ bdag gzhan bsrung ba'am zhi ba la de dang de la gdags so// rgyas pa ni/ gtsug lag khang du mchod par bya'o// dbang la ni mar dang sbrang rtsi'i nang du'o// mngon spyod la ni mchod rten la sogs pa'i 'og tu'o// bzhi pa ni/ shin tu tha mas sbyin sreg la brten pa ni thab kyi dbyibs dang tshad la sogs pa las bzhi'i bye brag gis tha dad par bya'o// dngos gzhi la lo ka'i me lha mchod pa'i rjes la lha rnams bskyed la sbyin sreg bya'o// bsreg rdzas ni til dang*/ zho dang*/ ut+pal dang*/ tsher ma rnams zhi ba la sogs la rim pas bsreg yang lhag mas lo ka pa'i me lha mchod pa la sogs pa thams cad gzhan dang thun mong ba'o// mngon par rtogs pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa mtha' dag bstan zin to// gal te rang ngam gzhan gyi don du bum pa la brten te khrus kyi cho gas las bzhi sgrub par 'dod na/

bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la mgul chings dang kha rgyan dang bcud bcug ste/ skad cig gis oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba yangs pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bskyed pa de'i nang du sngar bshad pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa cho ga bzhin bskyed nas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya ste/ bum pa'i steng gi rdo rje la gzungs thag btags nas rgyud ril po rdzogs par lan gcig gzhan rtsa sngags dang snying po nye snying rnams lan gsum mam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas shing*/ rang gi snying gi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas lha rnams dmar por gyur par bsams pas bdag gi dbang du 'dus te de rnams las 'od byung bas bdag la phog pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams zhing bzla'o// de'i mthar lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i chur bsams la/ rang ngam gzhan la blud pa dang gtor ba la sogs pa bya'o// de'ang zhi ba la sogs pa la kha dog gi dbye ba snga ma bzhin bya'o// rgyud sde bzhi dang rjes su bstun na bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud la bum pa'i steng du lha bsams pa de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bum par babs par bsam zhing zlos la/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen por byed na bum pa'i nang du lha bsam mo// da ni gzhung gi cha cung zad dgrol bar bya ste/ de la bsnyen pa dang las la sbyar ba ston par byed pa'i gzhung gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes bya ba nas rdo rje snying po rab tu smras te zhes bya ba'i bar gyis gtso bo bskyed pa'o// mi chod pa zhes bya ba nas rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa zhes bya ba'i bar ni khro bo bcu bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la gnyis las/ sems can thams cad bsrung ba zhes bya ba yan chad yan lag gi bya ba yin la/ lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras te zhes bya ba yan chad rtsa ba'i las yin no// rgyas par gzhung gi cha nyid du shes par bya'o// mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis mngon par rtogs pa zab pa'i rim pa mtha' dag bstan zin to// mthu stobs dbang phyug dri med gdams pa'i rgyun// ma 'dres mtha' dag gang gis brnyes gyur pa// bla ma'i gsung rab gus pas 'dod pa la// ji ltar rtogs bzhin rjes su bstan pa yin// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rnam par bshad pa bdud rtsi spel ba zhes bya ba gsang sngags 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis gzhan gyi don dang rang gi brjed byang du dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba rdzogs so//

༈ /rnam 'joms bir lugs bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po mthu stobs kyi mgon po'i bzhed pa'i man ngag gis dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi don nyams su blang ba'i cho ga ni/ rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste// zhes 'byung bas na spyir rgyud sde bzhi ka dang mthun par bsgrub pa yin la 'dir gtso bor rnal 'byor chen po dang mthun par bsgrub na bzhi ste/ bsnyen sgrub thun mong du gyur pa'i sgom bzlas bya ba dang*/ de sngon du song ba'i phrin las la sbyar ba dang*/ de dag la thun mong du dgos pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ rang gzhan la phan thogs pa'i don du bum pa'i cho ga'o// dang po la gnyis/ lha bskyed pa dang bzlas pa bya ba'o// dang po la gsum/ thabs kyi srung ba dang*/ shes rab kyi srung ba dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i srung ba'o// dang po la rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas rgyas par byed na/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnam par 'joms par gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bla ma dang lha bdun cu rtsa lnga'i tshogs kyi zhing mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la snying ga nas mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa spros la mchod pa dang*/ de nas rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad kyis yan lag bdun pa byas la/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms kyang nyes pa med do zhes kyang gsung la/ gtso cher 'di mdzad de/ thog mar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro bya/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang ldan cing sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral na re dga' snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/

de'i don du rdo rje rnam par 'joms par bsgom snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ gnyis pa shes rab kyi srung ba ni/ chos thams cad sems yin/ de yang sgyu ma lta bu yin/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis med pa yin snyam du bsams la ngag tu/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas snang ba mi dmigs pa'i stong par bsgom mo// gsum pa gnyis su med pa'i srung ba la bzhi las/ dang po dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsam/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ de'i phyi rol du me ri 'bar ba dang*/ steng du 'phros pas gur dang bla re dang 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsam/ de'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa rtsibs kyi nang thams cad khog stong lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa bsgom/ de'i nang du lte ba dang rtsibs bcu'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i gdan bcu gcig bsam/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang*/ drag po ste bdud bzhi'i gdan/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du phyogs skyong brgyad/ steng du nyi zla gnyis/ 'og tu sa bdag phag ste de rnams bsam/ de nas gdan dbus ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur bsdus te gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang ba/ cung zad khros pa la yid tsam 'dzum pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa bsgoms na zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'am/ yum med na g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ dar gyi sham thabs can/

rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa bsgom/ de nas phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams bskyed pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsams la/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas thugs kar zhugs pas bdag nyid kyi lus rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ de nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ las khro bo rnams sprul zhing ngag tu yang hūm̐ bcu rim gyis brjod pa'i rkyen gyis bskyed par bya ste/ shar phyogs su gshin rje gshed sngon po g.yas tho ba bsnams pa/ lho phyogs su shes rab mthar byed dkar po g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ nub phyogs su pad+ma mthar byed dmar po g.yas ut+pal dmar po 'dzin pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gtso bo dang tha dad med pas na byang phyogs su hūm̐ mdzad nag po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu thugs khar bsnol te 'dzin pa'o// byang shar du a tsa la nag po g.yas ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ṭa ki rā dza nag po g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu nī la daṇ+ḍa sngon po g.yas dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ma hā ba la nag po g.yas rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du tsakra wat+ti ser po g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po g.yas gtun shing 'dzin pa'o// hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan dgu po thams cad g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhabs g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa bsgom/ yang gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rdo rje'i pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi sprul la rtsibs kyi phyi rol gyi mu khyud kyi phyogs mtshams su brgyad brgyad dgod par bya ste/ kye rdo rje ma/ don yod rdo rje ma/ rdo rje gnod mdzes ma/ rdo rje bde bar 'gro ma/ rdo rje 'jigs par byed ma/

rdo rje las thams cad ma/ rdo rje thugs ma/ rdo rje sdig pa 'joms par byed ma ste brgyad po shar du'o// rdo rje bum pa ma/ rdo rje lta ba ma/ rdo rje don grub ma/ rdo rje las ma/ rdo rje dam tshig ma/ ku ru kul+le rdo rje ma/ rdo rje pra ba rī/ rdo rje dbang du byed ma ste brgyad po shar lhor ro// rdo rje zhags pa ma/ rdo rje rmongs byed ma/ rdo rje mgrin byed ma/ rdo rje gzhan gyi rig sngags 'ching ma/ rdo rje gzhan gyi rigs sngags phyir gso ma/ kye rdo rje dgyes ma/ rdo rje len ma/ rdo rje mig sman ma ste brgyad lhor ro// rdo rje sgrub pa ma/ rdo rje srung ma/ rdo rje don byed ma/ rdo rje lta ba ma/ rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ rdo rje snying gi zhags pa ma/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma/ rdo rje mgyogs ma ste brgyad po lho nub tu'o// rdo rje len pa ma/ rdo rje thams cad 'phrog ma/ rdo rje blang ma/ rdo rje ri khrod ma/ rdo rje bsnun ma/ rdo rje mdzes pa'i snye ma/ rdo rje me tog snyim pa mo/ rdo rje theg pa ma ste brgyad nub tu'o// rdo rje gdon dang rims nad kyis thebs su 'jug ma/ rdo rje byed pa ma/ rdo rje blo gros ma/ rdo rje sgra ma/ rdo rje khro ba ma/ rdo rje gnod mdzes ma/ rdo rje gtum mo/ rdo rje sbyin pa ma ste brgyad nub byang du'o// rdo rje shing lo ma dang*/ rdo rje nges par gnod mdzes ma/ rdo rje 'dod ma/ rdo rje phur bu ma/ rdo rje smra ba ma/ rdo rje dgod ma/ rdo rje mi 'jigs pa sbyin ma/ rdo rje spyan dra ma ste brgyad byang du'o// rdo rje rab sgrub ma/ rdo rje dga' bar byed ma/ rdo rje rang byung ma/ rdo rje thub pa ma/ ngag gi rdo rje ma/ rdo rje dbang du byed ma/ rdo rje thig le ma/ rdo rje srung ma ste brgyad byang shar du'o// de dag gi sku mdog ni shar gyi rnams dkar po/ lho'i rnams ser po/

nub kyi rnams dmar po/ byang gi rnams ljang gu/ mtshams kyi rnams phyed gzugs te shar lho'i rnams g.yas dkar la g.yon ser/ lho nub kyi rnams g.yas ser la g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang gi rnams g.yas dmar la g.yon ljang*/ byang shar gyi rnams g.yas ljang la g.yon dkar ba'o// thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ste/ phyag mtshan ni shar gyi rnams g.yas 'khor lo/ lho'i rnams rin po che/ nub kyi rnams pad+ma/ byang gi rnams ral gri/ byang shar gyi rnams lte ba la mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo/ shar lho pa rnams rdo rje/ lho nub pa rnams kyi pad+ma/ nub byang gi rnams ut+pal/ g.yon thams cad sdigs mdzub bo// yang na thams cad rdo rje dril bu 'dzin yang btub bo// zhes kyang gsung ngo*// gnyis pa sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ gsum pa ye shes pa gzhug pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros te lha bdun cu rtsa lnga'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim mo// bzhi pa dbang bskur ba ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od byung bas dbang bskur gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga la sogs pa spyan drangs la/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas lha rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gshin rje gshed la rnam snang*/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gtso bo la sogs pa khro bo dgu la mi bskyod pa/ pho nya mo rnams la shar gyi dang byang shar gyi la rnam snang*/ shar lho'i la mi bskyod pa/ lho'i dang lho nub kyi la rin 'byung*/ nub kyi la 'od dpag med/ nub byang dang byang gi la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa'o// yang na mdor bsdus pa ltar na dbang ma bskur bar dbu brgyan rang chas su bsams kyang rung ngo*// de dag gis ni srung ba gsum gyi lha bsgom pa'o// gnyis pa bzlas pa bya ba la sngags ni nye snying gtso bo 'ba' zhig gi'o// snying po khro bo bcu dang thun mong du'o// rtsa sngags rdo rje pho nya mo rnams dang thun mong du'o// yang na gsum ka yang gsum ka'i thun mong ba ste/

rtsa sngags kyi na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye zhes gtso bo'i 'o// ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ zhes pa khro bo bcu'i 'o// oṃ tra ṭa zhes pa man chad rdo rje pho nya mo'i 'o// snying po yang*/ pa ta ye zhes pa phan chad gtso mo'i 'o// ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye dang*/ oṃ ha ra sogs khro bo bcu'i 'o// mjug gi hūm̐ phaṭa pho nya mo'i 'o// nye snying yang*/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha gtso bo'i 'o// oṃ hu lu sogs khro bo bcu'i 'o// gsham gyi hūm̐ phaṭa pho nya mo'i 'o// zhes kyang gsungs te snga ma gtso bor mdzad do// de dag zlos pa'i tshe thog mar mas rim du lan 'ga' bzla ste/ dang po nye snying de nas snying po de nas rtsa sngags so// de nas rgyud kyi rim pa ltar bzla ste/ gang ltar yang lha'i sku la dmigs shing bzla bar bya'o// thun 'jog pa'i tshe lha dang srung 'khor la sogs pa thugs kar bsdus la gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya'o// srod thun gyi 'jug tu ni gtso bo yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu nas rim gyis bsdus nas/ stong pa'i ngang las nyal bar bya'o// de ltar sgom bzlas yun ring du byas pas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma ci rigs pa rnyed pa'am/ bzhi 'bum la sogs pa'i grangs yongs su rdzogs pa ni bsnyen sgrub thun mong ba'o// spyi don gnyis pa de la brten nas las la sbyar ba ni bzhi ste/ gang zag dbang po rab kyis bsam gtan la brten pa dang*/ 'bring gis sngags dang bsam gtan gnyis ka la brten pa dang*/ tha mas de dag gi steng du 'khrul 'khor dang*/ shin tu tha mal gyis de dag gi yang steng du sbyin sreg la brten te las bzhi bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni zhi ba la sogs pa las gang bsgrub par 'dod pa de la ched du dmigs nas lha bsgom zhing bsgrub bya gzhan gyi gdon zhi bar bya rgyu'am/ tshe rgyas pa la sogs pa de 'khor lo'i nang du bsams nas/

gang la dmigs pa de thogs pa med par 'grub bo// gnyis pa'ang dmigs pa dang bsam pa de lta bus lha bsgoms shing*/ shān+tiṃ ku ru la sogs pa so so'i spel tshig dang bcas pa'i sngags bzlas na 'grub bo// gsum pa ni/ bri ba'i gzhi gro ga'am ras sam shing shun la snag tsha/ skyes pa bsrung ba la gur gum dang*/ bud med bsrung ba la 'gi'u wang ngam/ yang na zhi ba la tsan+dan dkar po/ rgyas pa la gur gum mam 'gi wang*/ dbang la srin lag gi khrag gam rgya skyegs/ drag po la dug dang*/ khrag dang*/ skye tshe la sogs pa rnams kyis bri'o// dbyibs ni rtsibs bcu pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte ba la nye snying*/ rtsibs bcu la snying po'i sngags tshan pa bcu ru bgos la bri/ mu khyud la rtsa sngags bris te/ sngags thams cad la che ge mo la rak+ṣa ku ru dang*/ shān+tiṃ ku ru la sogs pa spel tshig dang bcas pa bri/ rab gnas gzhan dang mthun par byas la/ srung ba dang zhi ba la ni lus la bcangs pas 'grub par 'gyur ro// rgyas pa la ni gtsug lag khang du mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod pa dang*/ dbang la ni za ma tog la sogs pa'i nang du mar dang sbrang rtsi'i dbus su bzhag par bya ba dang*/ mngon spyod la ni mchod rten la sogs pa'i 'og tu mnan pa byas pas 'grub par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa sbyin sreg gis las bzhi bsgrub pa la thab kyi dbyibs ni zhi ba la zlum por bya'o// rgyas pa la gru bzhi/ dbang la zla gam/ drag po la gru gsum/ tshad ni brus pa'am bris pa gang ltar yang rung ste/ zhi ba'i rgyar khru gang*/ zabs su khru phyed/ rgyas pa'i rgyar khru do/ zabs su khru gang*/ dbang gi tshad zhi ba dang mthun/ drag po la rgyar sor nyi shu/ zabs su sor bcu/ kha dog ni zhi ba la dkar/ rgyas pa la ser/ dbang la dmar/ drag po la nag por byug par bya'o// kha khyer ni/ zhi ba la sor bzhi phyir bskyed cing dpangs su yang sor bzhi'o// rgyas pa la sor brgyad dang*/

dbang la sor bzhi dang*/ drag po la sor gsum mo// der las so so dang mthun pa'i bud shing brtsig go /g.yas g.yon du bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas bsham/ de nas bdag lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms la bzlas pa cung zad bya/ thab me sbar la/ nye snying zlos shing bdud rtsi'am dri chus gtor la thab dang yo byad bsang*/ swa bhā was thab khung stong par bsams la/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i thab las dang mthun par bskyed/ thab kyi dbus su ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las me lha sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ra skyes la zhon pa g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin par bskyed la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim/ dbang bskur nas zhi ba la rnam snang*/ rgyas pa la rin 'byung*/ dbang la 'od dpag med/ drag po la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas bsreg rdzas ci rigs pa phul te/ mchod pas mchod la me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par thim par bsams la thab kyi dbus su skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la mchod pas mchod la/ nye snying gi 'jug tu bsreg rdzas so so'i sngags kyi sham du shān+tiṃ ku ru la sogs pa las kyi sngags spel te/ mar dang yam shing sngon du 'gro ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pas dbul te/ de'ang zhi ba la gtso bor til/ rgyas pa la zho/ dbang la ut+pa la dmar po/ drag po la khrag dang*/ dug dang*/ yungs nag dang*/ tsher ma la sogs pa bsreg mchod pas mchod la/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ bzod par gsol zhing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ spyan drangs pa gshegs/ bskyed pa bdag la bsdu/ de nas yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha skad cig gis bskyed la/ lha'i sngags/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ rdzas so so'i sngags dang*/

las kyi sngags gsum spel la bsreg rdzas kyi lhag ma rnams phul la cho ga lhag chad kha bskang*/ bzod par gsol/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ ye shes pa gshegs/ bskyed pa bdag la bsdu/ me shi ba dang thal ba bsdus la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// spyi don gsum pa de dag thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul na kye rdo rje la sogs pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud gang yang rung ba nas bshad pa'i cho gas rdzas byin gyis brlab/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bskyed/ de la ye shes pa spyan drangs te gnyis su med par byas la/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gsum lan gsum gyis phul la me tog la sogs pa phul te/ ye shes pa gshegs la bskyed pa mi dmigs par bya'o// 'jig rten pa rnams la dpung bzang nas bshad pa'i cho gas sbyin par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// spyi don bzhi pa bum pa'i cho ga ni/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa legs par bkrus la/ ras la sogs pa gtsang mas mgul pa legs par bcing*/ bcud ci rnyed pa bcug la chu gtsang mas bkang ste/ shing lo rlon pas kha brgyan la maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa'i gzhi'i stegs la bzhag la de'i steng du dung chos su dri'i chu blugs la bzhag go /de'i steng du rdo rje la gzungs thag btags te bzhag go /de nas bdag lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms la/ swa bhā ba'i sngags kyis bum pa stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba yangs pa mchu 'phyang ba mgrin pa phra ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bskyed la/ de'i nang du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das lha bdun cu rtsa lnga yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la/ thog mar gleng gzhi nas brtsams te lag na rdo rjes smras so yan chad lan gcig brjod la/

gzungs thag nas bzung ste sngags thams cad rdzogs par zlos na nyer gcig gam snying po'am nye snying 'ba' zhig zlos na brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ bdag gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od byung ste gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas bum pa'i nang gi lha la 'od phog pas lha thams cad dmar lam song bar bsams nas/ bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsam/ yang na lha thams cad kyi sku las 'od byung nas bdag gi lus la phog pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing bzlas la/ bzlas pa'i mthar dung chos kyi chu blugs pas lha thams cad 'od du zhu bar bsam mo// de nas sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas zhes pa nas/ sdig pa kun las rnam par thar// zhes pa yan chad lan gcig brjod la bum pa'i chu de gtor ba dang blud pa dang*/ gdong bkru ba'i sgo nas gzhan la phan par bya ste zhi ba la sogs pa las gang la yang sbyar du rung ngo*// de ltar de dag rgyud sde 'og ma gsum po dang mthun par sgrub na sgom bzlas byed pa'i tshe bdag lhar mi bskyed par mdun du lha bskyed nas de la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul gyis sngags bzla'o// sbyin sreg dang bum pa'i bzlas pa'i don du'o// bdag lha'i rnal 'byor mi sgom pa ni bya ba'i rgyud kyi lugs so// bdag kyang lhar bsgom zhing mdun du'ang lha bskyed pa ni spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lugs so// bdag lhar bskyed pa la ye shes pa bcug ste bzlas brjod kyi mthar ye shes sems dpa' mdun du bton la bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol ba ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi lugs so// khyad par bum chog gi tshe bya spyod gnyis kyi lugs kyis bum pa'i steng du lha bskyed nas lha'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bum pa'i nang du 'dzag par bsgom pa yin la/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs kyis snga ma ltar bum pa'i nang du lha bskyed pa yin no// rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lugs la gtor ma dpung bzang gi cho ga kho nas so// nyams su blang ba'i cho ga thams cad bstan zin to// da ni de dag rgyud kyi gzhung dang ci rigs par sbyar ba la/

thog mar sgom bzlas bya ba'i gzhung ni/ 'di skad ces bya ba ni rgya gar gyi sgra las e waṃ zhes pa yin la/ waṃ gis thabs kyi srung ba bstan to// es shes rab kyi srung ba'o// stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su gtso bo bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje la bzhugs te/ zhes pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsgom pa ni rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ zhes pa'o// hūm̐ las 'od byung ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ lus rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs pa ni sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rjes lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas/ zhes pa dang*/ de nas lag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu dang*/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'khor sprul pa spyir bstan pa ni/ rdo rje khro bo las byung ba zhes pa'o// bye brag tu khro bo bcu brjod pa'i rkyen gyis bskyed pa ni rdo rje snying pos rab tu smras te/ zhes pa ste hūm̐ bcu smras pa'o// de las phyogs mtshams su khro bo bcu bskyed pa dngos ni/ mi chod pa la sogs pa tshig bcu dang*/ rig sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa la sogs pa tshig bcu'o// de ltar lha bskyed nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags bzlas pa yan chad ni bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung ngo*// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la yan lag gi las dang*/ rtsa ba'i las gnyis la/ dang po ni/ yang mi chod pa zhes pa nas sems can thams cad bsrung ba zhes pa yan chad de de ltar na mi chod pa la sogs pa de dag las sbyor gyi gzhung du mdzad do// rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas mi chod pa'i don ni rig sngags thams cad gnon pa'o// mi shigs pa ni rig sngags thams cad byed du 'jug pa'o// bden pa ni ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa'o// sra ba ni grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa'o// brtan pa ni thams cad brlag par byed pa'o// thams cad du thogs pa med pa ni 'byung po thams cad 'gugs par byed pa'o// thams cad du ma pham pa ni thams cad srung ba'o// sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa ni gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa'o// sems can thams cad 'jil bar byed pa ni las thams cad 'joms pa nyid do// rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa ni gzhan gyi las thams cad 'jig pa'o// zhes kyang gsung ngo*// rtsa ba'i las ni zhi ba rgyas pa zhes pa ni de nyid yin la/

sems can thams cad rengs pa dang rmugs pa ni mngon spyod kyi las yin zhing*/ yang rengs pa'i shugs la dbang du bya ba yang bsdu'o// gzhan srung 'khor dang sbyin sreg dang gtor ma gsum ni lha dang sngags kyi gzhung dag nyid kyi shugs la sngags bris pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ lha mchod pa sbyin sreg dang gtor ma'ang bstan par shes par bya'o// bum pa'i cho ga ni nor bu yungs kar dūr ba la sogs pa nyid do// sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas la sogs pa ni thams cad kyi thun mong du cho ga nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon no// dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi don nyams su blang ba'i rim pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po mthu stobs dbang phyug gi man ngag thun mong ma yin pa bla ma'i gsung las ji ltar rnyed pa bzhin du bla ma dang byang chub sems dpa' chen pos kas bskul nas shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa rig 'dzin grags kyis legs par bris pa'o// dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ /rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs bya tshul bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha siṃ hā ya/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i byin rlabs kyi bya tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po 'khar ba la sogs maṇ+ḍal khru gang las mi chung ba'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad/ shar gyi shar dang*/ nub kyi nub rnams su gtso bo dang khro bo bcu'i tshom bu dgod/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi'i tshom bu dgod de/ ma shong na nas rdog re re yang dgod do// de'i mthar mtshams 'dzin me tog chu bzhi nyer spyod dang*/ byang shar du gtor ma/ bum pa yang spyi dang mthun par bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril me tog sogs bsham mo// de nas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/

swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la zhes sogs kyis mchod byin kye rdor bzhin byas nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyud dang ldan par gyur cig sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur pa'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las ser po las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du dbus su bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og rnams su phyogs skyong bcu'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang gu cung zad khro ba/ yid tsam 'dzum pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ dar gyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas thugs kar thim pas lus thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ las khro bo rnams phyir spros te/ hūm̐ bcu brjod pa'i rkyen gyis shar du gshin rje gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma= byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje= byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri= shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu= lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa= nub byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum= steng du hūm̐ mdzad sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu rang rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar bsnol ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// yang gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams phyir spros te rim pa bzhin du shar du kye rdo rje ma/ don yod rdo rje ma/ rdo rje gnod mdzes ma/ rdo rje bde bar 'gro ma/ rdo rje 'jigs par byed ma/ rdo rje las thams cad ma/ rdo rje thugs ma/ rdo rje sdig pa 'joms par byed ma rnams sku mdog dkar mo/ shar lhor rdo rje bum pa ma/ rdo rje lta ba ma/ rdo rje don grub ma/ rdo rje las ma/ rdo rje dam tshig ma/ ku ru kul+le rdo rje ma/ rdo rje pra ba rī/ rdo rje dbang byed ma/ lhor rdo rje zhags pa ma/ rdo rje rmongs byed ma/ rdo rje mgrin byed ma/ rdo rje gzhan gyi rig sngags 'ching ma/ rdo rje gzhan gyi rig sngags phyir gso ma/ rdo rje dgyes ma/ rdo rje len ma/ rdo rje mig sman ma rnams ser mo/ lho nub tu rdo rje sgrub pa ma/ rdo rje srung ma/ rdo rje don byed ma/ rdo rje lta ba ma/ rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ rdo rje snying gi zhags ma/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma/

rdo rje mgyogs ma/ nub tu rdo rje len pa ma/ rdo rje thams cad 'phrog ma/ rdo rje blang ma/ rdo rje ri khrod ma/ rdo rje bsnun ma/ rdo rje mdzes pa'i snye ma/ rdo rje me tog snyim pa mo/ rdo rje theg pa ma rnams dmar mo/ nub byang du rdo rje gdon dang rims nad kyis thebs su 'jug ma/ rdo rje byed pa ma/ rdo rje blo gros ma/ rdo rje sgra ma/ rdo rje khro ba ma/ rdo rje gnod mdzes ma/ rdo rje gtum mo/ rdo rje sbyin pa mo/ byang du rdo rje shing lo ma/ rdo rje nges par gnod mdzes ma/ rdo rje 'dod ma/ rdo rje phur bu ma/ rdo rje smra ba ma/ rdo rje dgod ma/ rdo rje mi 'jigs pa sbyin ma/ rdo rje spyan dra ma rnams ljang gu/ byang shar du rdo rje rab sgrub ma/ rdo rje dga' bar byed ma/ rdo rje rang byung ma/ rdo rje thub ma/ ngag gi rdo rje ma/ rdo rje dbang du byed ma/ rdo rje thig le ma/ rdo rje srung ma'o// shar lho'i rnams g.yas dkar g.yon ser ba/ lho nub kyi lha rnams g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang gi lha rnams g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar gyi lha rnams g.yas ljang g.yon dkar ba ste thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ste/ shar gyi lha rnams g.yas 'khor lo/ lho'i lha rnams g.yas rin po che/ nub kyi lha rnams g.yas pad+ma/ byang gi lha rnams g.yas ral gri/ byang shar gyi lha rnams g.yas 'khor lo'i lte ba mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa/ shar lho'i lha rnams g.yas rdo rje/ lho nub kyi lha rnams g.yas pad+ma/ nub byang gi lha rnams g.yas ut+pa la bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje rnam 'joms lha bdun cu rtsa lnga'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sngags rgyas spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gshin rje gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gtso bo dang gzhan rnams la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje pho nya mo rnams la shar dang byang shar gyi lha rnams la rnam snang*/ shar lho'i lha rnams la mi bskyod pa/ lho dang lho nub kyi lha la rin 'byung*/ nub kyi lha la 'od dpag med/ nub byang dang byang gi lha la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas lha'i sku la dmigs pa'am/ yang na hūm̐ gis mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs te/ 'di skad bdag gis zhes pa nas rab tu smras so'i bar gyi lha dang sngags kyi che ba dran par byas la sngags kyi dngos gzhi ci nus bzla/ a mu kaṃ zhes pa'i tshab tu gnod byed ces 'don/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas// zhes pa nas/ rgyal po rtag tu khrus gyis shig /des ni rtag tu dge bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis cho ga'i phan yon dran pa lan gcig brjod pa ni rgyud kyi rim pa ltar bzlas pa'o// rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu pa'i 'khor lo la thim/ 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo la thim par bsam mo// zhes pa bdag bskyed do// gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma zhes sogs nas 'dus pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes sogs nas dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bya'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra re re sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes dang*/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma nang mchod chus sbyang*/ bsang sbyang*/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang gzungs ring gi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags sbyar ba'i phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya'o// bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du dbus su bdud bzhi dang phyogs mtshams steng 'og rnams su phyogs skyong bcu'i gdan dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes sogs nas yum dang bcas pa'o// shar du gshin rje gshed sngon po zhes sogs nas bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyi rol du rim pa bzhin du shar du kye rdo rje ma zhes sogs nas dbu brgyan zhes brjod/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams gong du bshad pa bzhin byas la/ gzungs thag blangs te/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba dmar po gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas lha rnams dmar lam song ste bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ 'di skad bdag gis zhes sogs nas dge bar 'gyur zhes pa'i bar gyis cho ga'i phan yon dran pa lan gcig brjod/ slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/

bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes sogs yig brgya lan gsum brjod de gzungs thag bsdus la ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyi mthar bum nang du chu blugs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i mthar mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod pa rnams grub nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang gis smin pa grangs nyer lnga las mi mang ba khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ slob dpon gyis nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyod rnams kyang gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong gis/ ku mud ltar dkar ba'i sa dkar logs rgyab yol gyi tshul du mdzad/ ya gi mon grog nas/ ma gi 'bal grog yan skyil krung gcig gis khengs par mdzad nas sa 'di nga dbang gsungs nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po la zhal mngon sum du bstan/ zla ba gcig gi bar du chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsung zhing*/ khyad par du rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis bla ma zhang dgon pa ba las ma brgyud pa mang du gsan pa'i nang nas thugs rtsis che bar grags pa lcags ri'i khongs las mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi las 'dir rnam 'joms bir lugs yin/ de'ang rgyud las/ rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste// dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan// zhes 'byung bas/

gang zag sbyangs pa che 'bring bzhi las/ gang zag dman pa phyi lus ngag gi bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbra la dga' ba la bya ba'i rgyud dang mthun par/ mdun du lha bskyed pa'i thugs kar sngags phreng bkod/ de'i mdun du rang nyid 'khod nas lha rje dpon lta bu las dngos grub len pa'o// de dang rjes su mthun par slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi bkral ba'i rdo rje rnam 'joms lha lnga'i sgrub thabs sogs ni bya rgyud rang rkang du bshad pa yin/ gang zag 'bring phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang nang ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam du spyod pa la dga' ba la spyod rgyud dang mthun par mdun du lha bskyed/ rang nyid lhar bskyed nas so so'i thugs kar sngags phreng bkod nas lha grogs po lta bu las dngos grub len pa'o// de dang mthun par slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas bkral ba'i rdo rje rnam 'joms lha lnga'i sgrub thabs ni spyod rgyud rang rkang ltar du bshad pa yin/ gang zag mchog ting nge 'dzin kho na la gtso bor spyod pa la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang mthun par bdag dam tshig pa bskyed la de la ye shes pa bcug nas/ slar ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba'o// de dang rjes su mthun par grub chen dze tā ris bkral ba'i rdo rje rnam 'joms gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs ni rnal 'byor rgyud rang rkang ltar du bshad pa yin/ gang zag ches mchog ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med pa la bla med kyi rgyud dang mthun par bdag dam tshig pa bskyed la de la ye shes pa bcug nas dam ye dbyer med du byed pa'o// de dang rjes su mthun par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas bkral ba'i rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa lha bdun cu don lnga'i sgrub thabs ni bla med ltar du bshad pa yin pas/ de ltar bzhi las/ 'dir phyi ma yin te/ rgyud las/ de nas lag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs dang*/

zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i zhal snga nas bkral ba'i gdams pa dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po las brgyud pa'i rdo rje rnam 'joms lha bdun cu don lnga'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlab pa zab mo bsgrub par bgyi/ de la spyir byin gyi rlabs pa de skur bar byed pa slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ slob dpon de nyid bcu shes shing*// mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan// phyag rgya sngags dang cho ga shes// las rnams kun la mkhas pa'o// zhes dang*/ brtag pa gnyis pa'i le'u dang po las/ rang 'dod lha mnyam rnal 'byor pas// rang mthong sngags kyi pha rol son// ces gsungs pas/ rdo rje slob dpon du dbang thob cing*/ bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa/ sngon chad las kyi cho ga mthong ba/ dkyil 'khor bri ba la sogs pa'i las la mkhas shing nus pa dang*/ khyad par du 'di'i byin rlabs thob cing brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las 'ong ba zhig cis kyang dgos pa yin/ gang la bskur ba'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ sam bu ṭa las/ dbang dang bka' gnang thob nas ni// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ bla med kyi dbang bskur/ mtshan nyid pa rdo rje'i lus skyon med par sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i sa bon thebs pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed phyin ci ma log par bsgrigs pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel gyi cho gas rgyu lam 'bras bu'i dus/ rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud sde'i dgongs pa/ grub pa'i slob dpon rnams las/ brgyud pa bzhin du dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa/ byin rlabs kyi dbang gis smin zhing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag la yon tan ma skyes pa bskyed pa'am/ skyes zin mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i don du sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs yin te/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig ldan// de la byin rlabs bya zhes gsungs// zhes gsungs pas so// dbang ma thob pa la rnam 'joms bir lugs sogs kyi byin rlabs byar mi rung ba yin te/

de nyid las/ dbang bskur med par byin brlabs na// dam tshig nyams par thub pas gsungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma la bya dgos par bshad lags/ gang gi tshe bskur ba'i dus ni gza' tshes skar ma sbyor byed bzang po 'dzom pa'i yar ngo'am/ de rnams lhag par 'dzom na mar ngo la nyes pa med de/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas nyid// yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya// gza' dang skar ma 'dzom gyur na// mar gyi ngo la nyes pa med// ces 'byung ba ltar du yar ngo la bya dgos pa yin/ gang du bskur ba'i gnas ni/ dbang mdor bstan las/ gang na sa skyong chos ldan cing*// gang zhig kho nar skye rgu rnams// bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa'i// gnas der rnal 'byor brtsam par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal po sa skyong zhing phyi nang nyer 'tshe med pa dgos/ khyad par du dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i gnas ni/ spyi rgyud las/ mchod rten chen po nyams dga' dang*// dben pa yi ni gnas dag dang*// ri yi rtse mo rgya chen du// dngos grub rnal 'byor brtsam par bya// zhes bya ba la sogs pa ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben pa zhig cis kyang dgos pa lags/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bya ba/ mdun bskyed bsgrub cing mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba/ bum pa bsgrub pa rnams sngon du grub zin nas/ gnyis pa khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob dpon la rdo rje rnam 'joms dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa'i slad du phyag me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// sogs tshig rkang drug dang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha bdun cu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas bzhugs par mos/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags pa la sogs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas/ don de rnams yid la dran bzhin pas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes sogs lan gsum brjod du gzhug zhes rgyud dag par byas nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pas bdag gi nad dang gdon dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs nas lus 'od phung du gyur par mos/ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rnams skad cig gis rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes pa nas yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur par mos nas/ slob dpon yang rdo rje rnam par 'joms par gsal ba'i thugs kar rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rlung phyir rgyu ba dang mthun pa'i hūm̐ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pa/ slob ma rnams kyi rlung nang du 'jug pa dang mthun par thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas phyir 'phros pas gnas khang dang yul phyogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang nas nad gdon la sogs pa zhi bar rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos/

yang thugs ka nas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rlung phyir rgyu ba dang mthun par hūm̐ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pa slob ma'i rlung nang du zhes sogs nas mos pa mdzod/ gu gul gyis bdug ngag tu hūm̐ nyer gcig brjod/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu sgra dang bcas te/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ zhes brjod pa'i sgo nas byin gyis brlabs nas/ de nyid brtan pa'i phyir du spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par byas nas/ de nas byin rlabs dngos zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnam smin gdos bcas kyis bsdus pa'i phung po skyed mched thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te/ de nyid la dmigs te oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes snang srid 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes sogs nas yum dang bcas pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs nas byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags dang rig sngags thams cad rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas khyed rnams la gnyis su med par thim par mos/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs te/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi zhes sogs nas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bum chu blud/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa re res dbu brgyan par mos nas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyang khyed rang la thim par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis me tog spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hās rab tu gnas par byas par mos pa mdzod/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnam 'joms su gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par bsams la/ che ba brjod pa tshar gcig bklag gzungs dngos kyi rjes gnang byar gzhug phan yon dran pa tshar gcig bklags la/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rgyud la rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig

ces brjod do// des bum dbang rjes 'brel dang bcas pa thob pa yin no// gsang dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon rdo rje rnam 'joms rang 'od kyi rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i mkha' nas thig le dkar dmar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i nang du thim pas lus thams cad gang bas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags nas gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par mos/ des gsang ba'i dbang thob pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnam par 'joms par gsal ba nyid rang 'od kyi rig ma dang thabs shes gnyis med kyi sbyor ba byas pas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos nas/ pad kor dang bcas pas 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas pas lhan skyes kyi ye shes skyes par mos pa mdzod/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin no// de nas dbang bzhi pa'i slad du zag bcas kyi bde ba de zag med stong pa gzung 'dzin dang bral ba chu zla lta bur yin snyam pa bsams la ma yengs par mnyam par bzhag go /de las rnam rtog gi sbun langs na/ yang 'di ltar bsams te/ phyi nang snod bcud 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin/ rmi lam gyi snang ba bzhin/ sems de yang sgyu ma yin te rgyu rkyen 'tshogs pa'i dus na sna tshogs su snang la/ rgyu rkyen ma 'tshogs na gang du'ang mi snang ba sgyu ma yin/ sgyu ma tsam du bden pa ma yin te/ kun rdzob snga ma la brten nas phyi ma 'byung ba rten 'brel yin zhing*/ don dam par rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pas brjod bral yin no snyam du rnam rtog ma skyes par mnyam par rtse gcig bzhag go /des dbang bzhi pa thob ste/ de ltar dbang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pas gtso bos dang*/

byin rlabs thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas sogs 'dra'o// byin rlabs tho sogs dpe tshan bzhi'i lung bya/ des rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs sogs gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ mchod bstod sogs nas nongs pa bzod gsol gyi bar bum bskyed bzhin bya/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyis bsdu/ bsngo ba dang bkra shis sogs bya'o// rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs 'di ni kun mkhyen rin po ches mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge gzhir byas/ bla ma dam pa'i phyag len gyis cung zad brgyan nas rdo rje 'chang bud+dha singha'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i dge slong brang ti pas gzhan don lhur mdzad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag gis bskul ba'i ngor myos byed kyi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i dga' ba bzhi pa'i nyin dpal e waṃ thar rtser bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
